# EcclesiaOS v1.0.43

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.43 strengthens role-based data isolation across members and operational modules, protects member deletion, and improves the member creation experience. Ministry leaders now work only with records related to their assigned ministry or records they created, branch pastors remain scoped to their branch, church administrators retain church-wide access, and super administrators retain global access.

## Security and permissions

- Added a reusable hierarchy-aware access scope for ministry, branch, church, and global roles.
- Restricted ministry leaders to members and operational records related to their assigned ministry, member, assignee, or creator ownership.
- Limited branch pastors to their assigned branch while allowing church administrators to work across all campuses in their church.
- Restricted individual member deletion, bulk deletion, and import rollback deletion to Super Administrators and Church Administrators.
- Scoped family, pastoral-care, finance, asset, bookstore, children and youth, counselling, and shared operational record access.
- Prevented household search filters and recent activity queries from escaping their authorized scope.
- Preserved limited ministry-contribution entry while enforcing the selected ministry assignment.

## Interface fixes

- Fixed Church Assignment dropdown overlap on the member creation page.
- Added inline dropdown layout support so Church, Campus, and Ministry menus expand inside their card instead of covering other controls or action buttons.
- Corrected active searchable-select stacking and card overflow behavior.

## Database migration

- Added nullable creator ownership fields to assets and bookstore products.
- Existing records remain valid; new and updated records retain their original creator ownership.
- Back up the application and database before installation. The managed updater applies the migration automatically.

## Verification

- Full application suite passed: 278 tests and 3,144 assertions.
- Permission, member deletion, household isolation, ministry finance, asset ownership, and member-create page regressions passed.
- Laravel Pint formatting passed.
- Blade template compilation passed.
- Production Vite assets built successfully.
